parameters.query: TRUNCATE messages, conversation_state, escalations, audit_log, outbox RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;
DELETE FROM orders WHERE order_id NOT IN ('ZH-10001','ZH-10002','ZH-10003','ZH-10004','ZH-10005','ZH-10006');

parameters.jsCode:
const WA_URL = 'https://zuri.prexx.online/webhook/900e6470-4e45-4b07-a686-2fff9ef8d8ee/whatsapp';
// ==============================

const ADA = '2348011112222', BOLA = '2348033334444', CHIDI = '2348055556666';

const T = [
  // ---- Product questions
  { id:'T01', name:'Price lookup', phone:ADA, text:'How much is the ceramic vase?',
    expected_text:'Replies with the price N15,000', expect:{ reply_contains:'15,000' } },
  { id:'T02', name:'Word order does not matter', phone:ADA, text:'vase ceramic price',
    expected_text:'Same product and price', expect:{ reply_contains:'15,000' } },
  { id:'T03', name:'Synonym match', phone:ADA, text:'do you have flower pot?',
    expected_text:'Finds Ceramic Vase', expect:{ reply_contains:'Ceramic Vase' } },
  { id:'T04', name:'Several matches', phone:ADA, text:'price of vase',
    expected_text:'Lists the matching products', expect:{ reply_contains:'few matches' } },
  { id:'T05', name:'Out of stock', phone:ADA, text:'how much is the brass lamp',
    expected_text:'Says it is out of stock', expect:{ reply_contains:'out of stock' } },
  { id:'T06', name:'Product not found', phone:ADA, text:'price of unicorn lamp',
    expected_text:'Says it could not find it', expect:{ reply_contains:'could not find' } },
  { id:'T07', name:'No product named', phone:ADA, text:'price?',
    expected_text:'Asks which product', expect:{ reply_contains:'which product' } },
  // ---- Delivery and payment
  { id:'T08', name:'Delivery info', phone:ADA, text:'delivery to Abuja?',
    expected_text:'Shows zones and fees', expect:{ reply_contains:'5,500' } },
  { id:'T09', name:'Payment info', phone:ADA, text:'I want to pay by bank transfer',
    expected_text:'Shows bank details', expect:{ reply_contains:'Demo Bank' } },
  { id:'T10', name:'Says paid, no order ID', phone:ADA, text:"I've paid",
    expected_text:'Waits for the order ID', expect:{ state:'payment_info/await_id' } },
  { id:'T11', name:'Gives the order ID', phone:ADA, text:'ZH-10001',
    expected_text:'Escalates to sales, state cleared',
    expect:{ escalation:'payment_verification/normal/sales', state:'none' } },
  // ---- Order status
  { id:'T12', name:'Order status (owner)', phone:ADA, text:'Where is ZH-10001',
    expected_text:'Shows awaiting payment', expect:{ reply_contains:'awaiting payment' } },
  { id:'T13', name:'Order status (someone else)', phone:BOLA, text:'Where is ZH-10001',
    expected_text:'Refuses: not matched to this number', expect:{ reply_contains:'could not match' } },
  { id:'T14', name:'Malformed order ID', phone:ADA, text:'track ZH-12',
    expected_text:'Explains the ID format and waits',
    expect:{ reply_contains:'ZH-12345', state:'order_status/await_id' } },
  { id:'T15', name:'Gives a valid order ID', phone:ADA, text:'ZH-10002',
    expected_text:'Shows delivered, state cleared', expect:{ reply_contains:'delivered', state:'none' } },
  { id:'T16', name:'No order ID given', phone:ADA, text:'where is my order',
    expected_text:'Asks for the order ID', expect:{ reply_contains:'order ID' } },
  { id:'T17', name:'Cancel', phone:ADA, text:'cancel',
    expected_text:'Cancels, state cleared, logged',
    expect:{ reply_contains:'cancelled', state:'none', audit_event:'flow_cancelled' } },
  // ---- Placing an order
  { id:'T18a', name:'Start an order', phone:CHIDI, text:'I want to buy a vase',
    expected_text:'Asks what to buy', expect:{ reply_contains:'What would you like', state:'place_order/item' } },
  { id:'T18b', name:'Name the product', phone:CHIDI, text:'ceramic vase',
    expected_text:'Asks how many', expect:{ reply_contains:'How many', state:'place_order/qty' } },
  { id:'T18c', name:'Give a quantity', phone:CHIDI, text:'2',
    expected_text:'Asks for the address', expect:{ state:'place_order/address' } },
  { id:'T18d', name:'Invalid address', phone:CHIDI, text:'Kano',
    expected_text:'Asks again', expect:{ reply_contains:'full address', state:'place_order/address' } },
  { id:'T18e', name:'Valid address', phone:CHIDI, text:'8 Aba Road, GRA, Port Harcourt',
    expected_text:'Asks for the name', expect:{ state:'place_order/name' } },
  { id:'T18f', name:'Give a name', phone:CHIDI, text:'Chidi Demo',
    expected_text:'Shows the summary and total N35,500', expect:{ reply_contains:'35,500' } },
  { id:'T18g', name:'Confirm the order', phone:CHIDI, text:'YES',
    expected_text:'Order created, sales alerted, state cleared',
    expect:{ escalation:'new_order/normal/sales', state:'none', new_order_total:'35500' } },
  // ---- Stuck intake
  { id:'T19a', name:'Start an order', phone:ADA, text:'I want to buy a vase', expected_text:'Setup step' },
  { id:'T19b', name:'Name the product', phone:ADA, text:'ceramic vase', expected_text:'Setup step' },
  { id:'T19c', name:'Bad quantity 1', phone:ADA, text:'abc', expected_text:'Setup step' },
  { id:'T19d', name:'Bad quantity 2', phone:ADA, text:'abc', expected_text:'Setup step' },
  { id:'T19', name:'Bad quantity 3', phone:ADA, text:'abc',
    expected_text:'Gives up and escalates to a human',
    expect:{ escalation:'intake_stuck/normal/sales', state:'none' } },
  // ---- Escalations
  { id:'T20a', name:'Start an order', phone:BOLA, text:'I want to buy a scarf', expected_text:'Setup step' },
  { id:'T20', name:'Asks for a person mid-order', phone:BOLA, text:'agent',
    expected_text:'Escalates to a human, state cleared',
    expect:{ escalation:'human_request/normal/sales', state:'none' } },
  { id:'T21', name:'Refund request', phone:ADA, text:'I want a refund',
    expected_text:'High priority, routed to the manager',
    expect:{ escalation:'complaint_refund/high/manager' } },
  // ---- Failure conditions
  { id:'T22', name:'Gibberish (low confidence)', phone:BOLA, text:'asdfgh',
    expected_text:'Escalates to a human and logs it',
    expect:{ escalation:'low_confidence/normal/sales', audit_event:'low_confidence' } },
  { id:'T23a', name:'First copy of a message', phone:ADA, text:'How much is the glass vase?',
    wa_id:'wamid.TEST.DUP1', expected_text:'Setup step' },
  { id:'T23', name:'Same message ID again (duplicate)', phone:ADA, text:'How much is the glass vase?',
    wa_id:'wamid.TEST.DUP1', expected_text:'Stored once, answered once, duplicate logged',
    expect:{ message_rows:1, reply_rows:1, audit_event:'duplicate_ignored' } },
  { id:'T24', name:'Image message', phone:CHIDI, type:'image', text:'',
    expected_text:'Passed to a human', expect:{ escalation:'media_received/normal/sales' } },
];

const stamp = Date.now();
return T.map((t, i) => {
  const waId = t.wa_id || `wamid.TEST.${stamp}.${i}`;
  const ts = String(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
  const message = t.type === 'image'
    ? { from: t.phone, id: waId, timestamp: ts, type: 'image', image: { id: 'media-1', mime_type: 'image/jpeg' } }
    : { from: t.phone, id: waId, timestamp: ts, type: 'text', text: { body: t.text } };
  const event = (t.expect && t.expect.audit_event) || '';

  const check_sql = `SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT text FROM outbox ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), '') AS reply,
    COALESCE((SELECT intent || '/' || step FROM conversation_state
              WHERE phone_hash = (SELECT phone_hash FROM contacts WHERE wa_phone = '${t.phone}')), 'none') AS state,
    COALESCE((SELECT category || '/' || priority || '/' || assigned_to FROM escalations ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 'none') AS escalation,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log WHERE event = '${event}')::int AS audit_count,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM messages WHERE wa_message_id = '${waId}')::int AS message_rows,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox WHERE request_id = '${waId}')::int AS reply_rows,
    COALESCE((SELECT total_ngn::text FROM orders WHERE customer_name = 'Chidi Demo' AND status = 'awaiting_payment' LIMIT 1), 'none') AS new_order_total`;

  return { json: {
    id: t.id, name: t.name, phone: t.phone, text: t.text || '(image)', wa_id: waId,
    url: WA_URL, expected_text: t.expected_text || '', expect: t.expect || null, check_sql,
    payload: { object: 'whatsapp_business_account', entry: [{ id: '101234567890123', changes: [{ field: 'messages', value: {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      metadata: { display_phone_number: '2348099999999', phone_number_id: '109876543210987' },
      contacts: [{ profile: { name: 'Test User' }, wa_id: t.phone }],
      messages: [message] } }] }] }
  } };
});
